findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded for web requests
findings.body: The only call to I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! is in ApplicationController#set_locale. Server-side translations also occur in Sidekiq jobs, mailers, rake tasks, and console/background processes, where this filter never runs. The lazy loader in translate_accelerator only loads config.locale, not the site-default or :en fallback locales, so in a job-only process those YAML files may never enter the backend store and a missing translation will return 'translation missing' instead of falling back. Fallback loading should be ensured from I18n.translate/load_locale or from the job/mailer locale setup, not only from the web controller.

findings.title: Translation cache can retain missing or stale fallback results after locales load
findings.body: The LRU cache key is only key + current locale + backend object_id, and load_locale/ensure_loaded! add translations without clearing @cache (only reload! clears it). If a key is first translated before its fallback locale has been loaded, the 'translation missing' string produced for that lookup is stored by getset and will keep being returned after the fallback file is loaded, until eviction or reload. The same staleness occurs when SiteSetting.default_locale changes, because FallbackLocaleList then points at a different fallback locale while the cache key is unchanged, so strings cached from the old fallback locale continue to be served. Loading a locale should invalidate the cache, or missing results and the effective fallback chain must be accounted for in caching.

findings.title: Fallback lookup consults SiteSetting on every translation
findings.body: I18n::Backend::Fallbacks invokes I18n.fallbacks[locale] for each backend translation, and the translate accelerator bypasses its cache for the common calls that pass interpolation, count, or locale options. This implementation therefore rebuilds the fallback array and calls the DB-backed SiteSetting.default_locale (with to_sym) on a per-translation hot path, and makes plain I18n.t depend on site-settings availability even in boot or isolated job contexts. The chain should be computed when the locale/site default is set, or memoized keyed by the current site/default locale with invalidation when that setting changes.

findings.title: No tests cover the new fallback behavior
findings.body: The PR adds FallbackLocaleList, fallback-backend inclusion, lazy fallback loading, and a controller hook, but adds no specs. There is no coverage proving the user-locale -> site-default -> :en order, that fallback translation files are loaded on demand (including pluralized/interpolated keys that bypass the accelerator cache), or that non-controller translation paths fall back correctly. Such tests are needed because the failure mode is silent: missing keys degrade to 'translation missing' strings rather than raising in production.
